item.tib: mkha' 'gro snying thig dgongs pa rang grol las ma bzhi lha dang gzhal yas mngon mjal thabs 'od gsal nyi ma 'bum shar
item.coloph: ces mkha' 'gro snying thig dgongs pa rang grol gyi rgyud las/ 'od gsal nyi ma 'bum shar zhes bya ba 'di ni/ snying gi grogs mchog dam pa rnams kyis nan tur bskul ba'i ngor/ phyi ma'i don gnyer rnams la phan sems kyi blo dang bcas te/ snyigs dus kyi rnal 'byor ba 'ja' tshon snying pos mkha' 'gro 'dus gnas nyi ma rang shar gyi gnas su brtsams pa/ sa rta zla ba drug pa'i zhi ba'i phyogs su bgyis pa 'dis kyang gsang sems bon gyi bstan pa'i rgyan du gyur cig
